# Command-line options

*Generated by `python -m kidpack.optionsdoc --output docs/OPTIONS.md` from the real argument parsers; do not edit by hand (a test fails if this file is out of date). `<KIDPACK>` is the checkout of this repository.*

The same information is printed by `<command> --help`. A value written like `5.4e9` means 5.4 x 10^9; numbers can be given in that form (`--sample-rate 2.5e9`). Negative values can be given as usual (`--power -2`, `--trigger-level -8e-5`).

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`kidpack-daq`](#kidpack-daq) | Pulse DAQ: acquires waveforms with the NI-SCOPE digitizer |
| [`kidpack-monitor`](#kidpack-monitor) | Online check of a raw file: pc1 / pc2 of 16 events |
| [`kidpack-iqscan`](#kidpack-iqscan) | IQ scan: transmission versus frequency |
| [`kidpack-iqplot`](#kidpack-iqplot) | Quick look at an IQ scan |

## kidpack-daq

Acquire KID waveforms with an NI-SCOPE digitizer (exit code: 0 completed, 130 stopped with Ctrl-C, 1 error).

### run control

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--run-number` `N\|test` | integer, 0 or more; or the word `test` (see Rules) | - | run number XX: output goes to run_XX/ and an existing run is never reused. Default: the next free number. "test": output goes to run_test/, replacing the previous test run |
| `--events-per-file` | integer, 1 or more | required | events (waveforms) per output file |
| `--num-files` | integer, 1 or more | required | number of files to acquire; Ctrl-C stops earlier and keeps the data so far |
| `--condition` | text (tabs and line breaks become spaces) | (empty) | free-text measurement condition (temperature, bias, ...), recorded in the run summary and the YAML |
| `--output-dir` | directory path | `<KIDPACK>/data` | directory in which run_XX/ is created |
| `--summary-file` `PATH` | file path | - | run summary text file, one line appended per run (default: OUTPUT_DIR/run_summary.txt) |
| `--backend` | `niscope`, `simulator` | `niscope` | 'simulator' needs no hardware (for testing) |

### digitizer / horizontal

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--resource` | NI-SCOPE resource name, e.g. `PXI2Slot2` | `PXI2Slot2` | NI-SCOPE resource name |
| `--sample-rate` `HZ` | number [Hz], more than 0 (the digitizer takes the nearest rate it has; max 2.5e9) | `2.5e9` | minimum sample rate [Hz] |
| `--time-window` `S` | number [s], more than 0 (not together with `--npts`) | - | record length [s] (default: 2e-06); npts = sample-rate x time-window |
| `--npts` | integer, 1 or more (not together with `--time-window`) | - | samples per record (alternative to --time-window) |
| `--ref-position` `PERCENT` | number [%], 0 to 100 | `20` | trigger position in the record [%] |
| `--fetch-timeout` `S` | number [s], more than 0 | `100` | max wait for one trigger [s]; Ctrl-C is only handled after this wait returns |

### digitizer / vertical

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ch0-range` `V` | number [V], more than 0 (the digitizer takes the nearest range it has) | `0.01` | ch0 vertical range [V] |
| `--ch0-coupling` | `dc`, `ac`, `gnd` | `dc` | ch0 coupling |
| `--ch0-offset` `V` | number [V], any | `0` | ch0 vertical offset [V] |
| `--ch1-range` `V` | number [V], more than 0 (the digitizer takes the nearest range it has) | `0.01` | ch1 vertical range [V] |
| `--ch1-coupling` | `dc`, `ac`, `gnd` | `dc` | ch1 coupling |
| `--ch1-offset` `V` | number [V], any | `0` | ch1 vertical offset [V] |
| `--impedance` `OHM` | number [ohm], more than 0 (normally 50 or 1e6) | `50` | input impedance of both channels |
| `--bandwidth` `HZ` | number [Hz]; -1 = full bandwidth | `-1` | max input frequency of both channels, -1 = full |

### trigger

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--random-trigger` | (flag: no value) | off | issue a software trigger every --random-trigger-interval seconds instead of waiting for an edge trigger |
| `--random-trigger-interval` `S` | number [s], more than 0 (only with `--random-trigger`) | - | seconds between random triggers (default: 1) |
| `--trigger-source` | text: `VAL_EXTERNAL` (external trigger input) or a channel name such as `0`, `1` | `VAL_EXTERNAL` | trigger source, e.g. VAL_EXTERNAL or a channel name |
| `--trigger-level` `V` | number [V], any | `2.2` | trigger level [V] |
| `--trigger-slope` | `positive`, `negative` | `positive` | edge slope that triggers |
| `--trigger-coupling` | `lf_reject`, `hf_reject`, `dc`, `ac`, `ac_plus_hf_reject` | `dc` | coupling of the trigger input |

### signal generator (optional)

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sg-frequency` `HZ` | number [Hz] (together with `--sg-power`) | - | signal generator frequency [Hz] (needs --sg-power) |
| `--sg-power` `DBM` | number [dBm] (together with `--sg-frequency`) | - | signal generator power [dBm] (needs --sg-frequency) |
| `--sg-resource` | resource name (only with `--sg-frequency` and `--sg-power`) | - | SG resource name (default: PXI2Slot3) |

### Rules

- `--run-number` is optional: without it the next free number is used (the highest of the `run_NN` directories and of the run summary, plus 1; 1 if there is none).
- A run number that already has a directory is refused. The exception is `--run-number test`: it writes to `run_test/` and replaces the previous test run (its files are deleted once the instruments are ready), unless that directory holds files that are not DAQ output (then nothing is deleted). Test runs never count as numbers; the summary gets one line per test run.
- `--time-window` and `--npts` cannot be given together.
- `--sg-frequency` and `--sg-power` must be given together; `--sg-resource` needs both.
- `--random-trigger-interval` needs `--random-trigger`.
- `--random-trigger` cannot be combined with `--trigger-source`, `--trigger-level`, `--trigger-slope` or `--trigger-coupling` set to something else than their default.

## kidpack-monitor

Online check of a raw NPZ file: pc1 (IQ plane) and pc2 (waveforms) of 16 events in a 4x4 grid, saved as pc1.png / pc2.png and shown in windows (close them to exit). The data is only read.

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` (positional) | path of a raw `.npz` file | - | raw .npz file (default: the newest one under --data-dir) |
| `--run-number` `N\|test\|MMDD_HHMMSS` | integer, 0 or more; `test`; or a start time `MMDD_HHMMSS` (e.g. `0831_155251`) | - | instead of FILE: the file of this run under --data-dir (run_XX/data/runXX-YY.npz); with --file-number that file, otherwise the one with the highest file number. Besides a number and "test", a run can be named after its start (0831_155251, as made by kidpack.legacy from files of the old DAQ macro) |
| `--file-number` `M` | integer, 0 or more (needs `--run-number`) | - | file number YY within the run given by --run-number |
| `--data-dir` | directory path | `<KIDPACK>/data` | where to look for the newest file |
| `--output-dir` | directory path | `.` | where pc1.png and pc2.png are written |
| `--rebin` `N` | integer, 1 or more | `5` | average N consecutive samples before locating the peak; the points in pc1 are these averages |
| `--no-show` | (flag: no value) | off | only write the PNG files, do not open windows (e.g. on a machine without a display) |
| `--alpha` | (flag: no value) | off | pedestal from the first 100 ns instead of the pre-trigger region |
| `--stride` `K` | integer, 1 or more | `1` | plot every K-th event, starting from the first |

### Rules

- The file is chosen in this order: `file`; or `--run-number` (with `--file-number`: `<data-dir>/run_XX/data/runXX-YY.npz`, without it the file with the highest file number of that run); or, with none of them, the newest `run*-*.npz` under `--data-dir`. A run named after its start (`--run-number 0831_155251`: `run_0831_155251/data/run0831_155251-00.npz`) is one made from a file of the old DAQ macro by `kidpack.legacy`; `kidpack-daq` writes only numbers and `test`.
- `file` and `--run-number` / `--file-number` cannot be given together; `--file-number` needs `--run-number`.

## kidpack-iqscan

Frequency scan of the transmission (IQ scan): for each frequency the signal generator is set and started, the digitizer acquires, and the mean I (ch0) and Q (ch1) are stored (exit code: 0 completed, 130 stopped with Ctrl-C, 1 error).

### scan

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--f-start` `HZ` | number [Hz], more than 0 | required | first frequency [Hz] |
| `--f-stop` `HZ` | number [Hz], more than 0 (may be below `--f-start`) | required | last frequency [Hz] |
| `--num-points` | integer, 1 or more | required | number of frequencies, evenly spaced, both ends included |
| `--power` `DBM` | number [dBm], any finite value | `-2` | signal generator power [dBm] |
| `--settle-time` `S` | number [s], 0 or more | `0` | wait between starting the generator and acquiring, per point |

### output

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--condition` | text (tabs and line breaks become spaces) | (empty) | free-text measurement condition (temperature, ...), recorded in the summary and the YAML |
| `--output-dir` | directory path | `<KIDPACK>/data/iqscan` | directory of the scan files |
| `--name` `STEM` | file name without directory and extension (not `.` or `..`) | - | file name without extension (default: iqscan_YYYYMMDDHHMM); an existing file is never overwritten |
| `--summary-file` `PATH` | file path | - | scan summary text file, one line per scan (default: OUTPUT_DIR/iqscan_summary.txt) |
| `--backend` | `niscope`, `simulator` | `niscope` | 'simulator' needs no hardware (for testing) |

### digitizer

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--resource` | NI-SCOPE resource name, e.g. `PXI2Slot2` | `PXI2Slot2` | NI-SCOPE resource name |
| `--sample-rate` `HZ` | number [Hz], more than 0 | `10000` | minimum sample rate [Hz] |
| `--time-window` `S` | number [s], more than 0 (not together with `--npts`) | - | record length [s] (default: 1); npts = sample-rate x time-window |
| `--npts` | integer, 1 or more (not together with `--time-window`) | - | samples per record (alternative to --time-window) |
| `--num-records` | integer, 1 or more | `2` | records acquired and averaged per frequency |
| `--ref-position` `PERCENT` | number [%], 0 to 100 | `50` | reference position in the record [%] |
| `--ch0-range` `V` | number [V], more than 0 | `1` | ch0 vertical range [V] |
| `--ch0-coupling` | `dc`, `ac`, `gnd` | `dc` | ch0 coupling |
| `--ch0-offset` `V` | number [V], any | `0` | ch0 vertical offset [V] |
| `--ch1-range` `V` | number [V], more than 0 | `1` | ch1 vertical range [V] |
| `--ch1-coupling` | `dc`, `ac`, `gnd` | `dc` | ch1 coupling |
| `--ch1-offset` `V` | number [V], any | `0` | ch1 vertical offset [V] |
| `--impedance` `OHM` | number [ohm], more than 0 (normally 50 or 1e6) | `1e6` | input impedance of both channels |
| `--fetch-timeout` `S` | number [s], more than 0 | `17` | max wait for the acquisition of one point [s] |

### signal generator

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sg-resource` | signal generator resource name, e.g. `PXI2Slot3` | `PXI2Slot3` | signal generator resource name |

### Rules

- `--time-window` and `--npts` cannot be given together.
- An existing scan file (same `--name`, or the same start minute) is never overwritten.

## kidpack-iqplot

Quick look at an IQ scan: ch0 vs ch1, frequency vs |S21|, frequency vs arg S21, shown in a window (close it to exit). The data is only read.

| Option | Allowed values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` (positional) | path of an IQ-scan `.npz` file | - | IQ-scan .npz file (default: the newest one under --data-dir) |
| `--data-dir` | directory path | `<KIDPACK>/data/iqscan` | where to look for the newest file |
| `--ref` `FILE` | path of an IQ-scan `.npz` file with the same frequencies | - | reference scan at the same frequencies: S21 = scan / ref (as plot_iq_scan.py); without it the stored values are shown uncalibrated |
| `--db` | (flag: no value) | off | magnitude in dB instead of linear |
| `--wrap` | (flag: no value) | off | fold the phase into (-pi, pi] instead of showing it continuously |
| `--save` `PNG` | path of the PNG file to write | - | also write the figure to this PNG file |
| `--no-show` | (flag: no value) | off | do not open a window (use with --save, e.g. without a display) |

### Rules

- `--no-show` needs `--save` (otherwise there would be nothing to do).
- `--ref` must have been measured at the same frequencies as `file`.
- Without `file`, the newest `*.npz` directly under `--data-dir` is used.
